verdict.rationale: The only official CLI in the evidence is Honeymarker, which Honeycomb describes as its lightweight marker-management tool offering CRUD on markers from the command line. That is a narrow, single-purpose tool, not a general CLI for AI-native workflows. Broader programmatic control is documented only through the REST API and MCP server. missing for 10: a general-purpose official CLI covering queries, datasets, triggers, SLOs and boards, documented agent-friendly CLI workflows (e.g. structured output or auth for automation), independent or hands-on corroboration.
